subject: Activation playbook & trial success metrics — CloudBridge next steps
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rivera <sam@cloudbridge.ai>, Anita Desai <anita@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Activation playbook & trial success metrics — CloudBridge next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + proposed activation playbook so we all have the same page going into the trial kickoff. TL;DR: agreed scope = internal doc search + customer support summarization; success metrics & owners below.

Pain points you shared
- Support tickets take ~18–24 hours to categorize and route; CS workload rising week-over-week
- Knowledge base search returns low-relevance results for long-tail queries
- Need strict PII handling for support transcripts

Goals for the 4-week trial (agreed)
1) Reduce average triage time by 30% on support queues for English language tickets
2) Improve top-3 search precision for KB queries by +20% (pilot eval)
3) Demonstrate safe-handling: zero PII leakage in model outputs on our test set

Scope & technical approach
- Modules: retrieval-augmented generation for KB search; light reranker for triage routing; prompt templates and fail-safe filters for PII
- Data: subset of anonymized support transcripts (we requested 5k rows sample), KB export (top articles)
- Model surface: Redwood-hosted open model (gptj-compat quantized), can fallback to smaller model for cost control

Success metrics (how we’ll measure)
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end inference <= 350ms for single-query path under test load
- Cost: target token cost <= $0.0015 per query (estimated; will report actual)
- Quality: top-3 search precision delta +20% over baseline; triage accuracy improvement by intent F1 +0.15
- Safety: automated prompt-set eval with 0 PII leaks on held-out set

Prompt set & evals
- We’ll provide an initial prompt pack of ~200 labeled examples (search+triage) and run Redwood’s eval harness daily; iterate prompts based on failing tiers

Owners & timeline
- CloudBridge owner: Sam Rivera (technical) / Anita Desai (product)
- Redwood owner: Aisha Rahman (trial lead) / Vivek Kulkarni (solutions eng)
- Week 0 (this week): access + data handoff; baseline metrics collection
- Week 1: initial model + prompt tuning; run first eval
- Week 2: config for batching/quantization; stability run
- Week 3: acceptance tests against KPI thresholds; safety audit
- Week 4: final readout + handoff recommendations

Access & setup items we still need from CloudBridge (action items)
1) S3 access or secure transfer link to anonymized support transcripts (5k rows) — deliver by Tue 2026-10-06
2) Shared Drive read access for KB export (or compressed dump)
3) Test account with sample traffic pattern (if possible) or a replayable CSV of queries
4) Point person for security questionnaire: procurement@cloudbridge.ai (we flagged a couple SOC 2 questions today)

Attachments: redwood-activation-playbook.pdf (attached) — includes laboratory prompts, eval plan, and quick runbook for the trial. Also attached a blank SOW template for procurement to review.

Immediate next steps
- Sam / Anita: confirm data delivery date and procurement contact (procurement@cloudbridge.ai)
- Vivek: I’ve asked you to provision the test environment and draft initial prompt set (cc’d)
- Lauren: I’ll ping you separately if we need SLA escalation or credits for extended runs

If this looks right, Sam can reply with dates and access links and we’ll schedule the Week 0 kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Aisha.Rahman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-activation-playbook.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sam Rivera <sam@cloudbridge.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Desai <anita@cloudbridge.ai>, procurement@cloudbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Activation playbook & trial success metrics — CloudBridge next steps

Thanks Aisha — this is great and matches what we discussed. A few notes / confirmations from our side: 

1) Data delivery: we can provide an anonymized CSV (5,200 rows) and a KB dump by Tue 2026-10-06 EOD. I’ll share a secure S3 pre-signed link to you and Vivek when the upload completes.
2) Security / procurement: procurement@cloudbridge.ai is on this thread — they asked for a short SOW and a DocuSign-friendly version of terms. I’ve attached our internal SOW template and asked procurement to review.
3) Test traffic: we can provide a replay CSV for week-0 baseline. Expect to share the replay file with the S3 link as well.
4) PII handling: Anita will coordinate a quick checklist with our security team; they want to confirm encryption at rest for interim storage and an initial data retention window of 30 days for the trial artifacts.

We’re OK with Redwood hosting the model for the trial. One ask: can Redwood provide the initial prompt pack (200 examples) in the same format as your eval harness? If so, we’ll expedite the data drops.

I’m cc’ing procurement; procurement, please let us know if the SOW template is sufficient and whether you need a vendor questionnaire filled.

Thanks — Sam

--
Sam Rivera
Head of Integrations, CloudBridge
sam@cloudbridge.ai | +1 (206) 555-0119

Attachment: cloudbridge-sow-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Rivera <sam@cloudbridge.ai>, Anita Desai <anita@cloudbridge.ai>, procurement@cloudbridge.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation playbook & trial success metrics — CloudBridge next steps

Vivek / Lauren — quick internal note after Sam's confirmation.

What I see as our immediate actions (I’ll own coordination):
- Vivek: expect the S3 pre-signed link and replay CSV by Tue EOD. Please provision the sandbox and start the baseline collection as soon as the files are available. Draft initial 200-example prompt pack by Wed and drop to the Drive link in my note.
- Vivek: please include the safety checks (PII detectors + fail-closed) in the first pass — Anita flagged encryption + 30-day retention so we can propose short-term retention on our side for the artifacts.
- Lauren: can you confirm budget guardrails? If we exceed the token cost estimate I may need to request a short credit or throttle policy during Week 2.

I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Wed 2026-10-07 10:00 PT unless any objections — will send calendar invite in a moment.

Thanks — will update thread with the S3 link once Sam shares.

—
Aisha
